sloka: स शरैः अर्पितः क्रुद्धः सर्व गात्रेषु राघवः ।रराज समरे रामो विधूमो अग्निर् इव ज्वलन् ॥३-२८-१९॥
transliteration: sa śaraiḥ arpitaḥ kruddhaḥ sarva gātreṣu rāghavaḥ ।rarāja samare rāmo vidhūmo agnir iva jvalan ॥3-28-19॥

translations.english: Rama, scion of the Raghu race, afflicted by the darts in all parts of the body, glowed in his anger like smokeless fire burning.
